reason: Spain international defender who joined Real Madrid from Chelsea in June 2026 under a contract to 30 June 2032. Eight opened sources, including LaLiga and Chelsea official pages. Transfer fee is not disclosed by either club; press reports give a base fee of EUR 55m (AFP, US$63.8m) plus EUR 5m in add-ons (Fabrizio Romano via TheHardTackle; GeoSuper cites international media).
